story.title: Up above the world so high!
paragraphs_en: Let's Go Outside. Lay on your back and watch what is there in the sky? Are you ready?

Can you see the blue sky and clouds? Some are white, some are grey. But when it is going to rain, the clouds are dark and black. If it looks black now, g et inside the house. Come back later to look up!
Sometimes you can see kites swaying in the sky Waving a real big 'HI'!
Or a lot of butterflies If flowers are near-by!!
You may see crows fly Oh! can you hear them cry?
And airplanes zipping across Leaving white trails as they pass
It becomes bright orange and red When the sun is ready to set!
Next, come the moon and starry night! Look what a beautiful sight!
Wait! it's not yet over! Let's use a telescope to see deeper!!
Those shooting stars are meteors! Burning as they fall to earth!!
Can you see the stars forming patterns? Those are called constellations!
There are lots of satellites orbiting. In the space between the moon and the earth. They are man-made. To help us in various ways.
One of which is ISS(International Space Station). Where astronauts work flying around the station!
Farther than the moon, come lines of planets in our solar system. They all orbit our sun just like we do. They look shiny but not twinkle at night when you see with naked eyes.
Humans have launched rockets into space. It helps us understand what is life's base.

Sun, its eight planets, meteors and comets form the solar system. We have sent a satellite that has crossed the whole solar system and continues to travel into space. Its called Voyager 1. It is the most distant man-made object from the Earth.
Lots of stars combine to form Galaxy. Our solar system is in a galaxy named "Milky Way". There are lots and lots of galaxies in Space. Yet Earth is the only place to host life as far as we know!!!
